name: @radix-guild/alert-policy
description: Edge-triggered operator alerts with backoff reminders, recovery notices and inhibition — the one policy every bigdev bot pages through. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.ts --format esm --target node --outfile dist/index.js && bun build src/index.ts --format cjs --target node --outfile dist/index.cjs
scripts.smoke:node: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.decide !== 'function' || typeof m.createAlertEvaluator !== 'function') throw new Error('esm exports missing'); console.log('node esm ok:', Object.keys(m).length, 'exports') })" && node -e "const m = require('./dist/index.cjs'); if (typeof m.decide !== 'function' || typeof m.SqliteAlertStore !== 'function') throw new Error('cjs exports missing'); console.log('node cjs ok:', Object.keys(m).length, 'exports')"
